evidence_refs.quote: Paper, a San Francisco design platform built for teams shipping software alongside AI coding agents
Paper is the design platform for the agentic era. Founded by Stephen Haney, Paper is built for teams shipping software with AI and coding agents

Unlike traditional design tools built around proprietary canvases, Paper renders with HTML and CSS, enabling designs to connect directly with production code and the agents increasingly responsible for creating it.
Paper's design environment is built to work natively alongside agentic coding workflows rather than assuming a purely human-to-human pipeline.

Arrakis, a London and Paris startup building what it calls an AI operating system for industrial companies, has emerged from stealth with $38 million in total funding
Arrakis, a London and Paris startup building what it calls an AI operating system for industrial companies

Rather than locking customers into a single model provider, Arrakis takes a model-agnostic approach, starting with commercial models from OpenAI and Anthropic before shifting workloads to open-source alternatives from vendors like Mistral
The startup deploys what it describes as forward-deployed AI engineers who embed directly at customer sites

Pathwork is the AI platform purpose-built for the distribution side of life & health insurance, transforming how policies are sold, placed, and retained.
An AI-native platform that brings clarity, speed, and confidence to the people powering insurance—so they can spend less time chasing answers and more time driving impact.

APS files are uploaded into Pathwork Summaries are generated in minutes – even for large files Underwriters validate key findings by clicking directly into source pages Chat-with-files enables targeted searches across thousands of pages

Pathwork and NGL Insurance Company (NGL), in partnership with LifeCare Assurance Company, announced the launch of PreQual Manager, an AI-powered inbox that enables underwriting teams to respond to broker inquiries faster and more consistently.
